cs.t: Throttled motors on ebikes are terribly unsafe, compared to pedal assist central motors.  Feels like an overgeneralization. I have a perfectly slow Ride1Up Roadster V3. It's a PA bike with a throttle, but it's not a hot rod. Max speed with my weight is around 20MPH. I use the throttle to just get moving on inclines or at stops when I forgot to downshift. That said, there are plenty of idiots around on bikes and cars.  https://ride1up.com/product/roadster-v3/

There are plenty of modern ebikes that are just bikes with a motor. I have one of these for instance (well, the previous generation):  https://ride1up.com/product/roadster-v3/  The best description I've seen of using it is "cycling without hills". The fact that we use the same name for these and "low speed electric motorcycles" is... unfortunate.
